blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Southwest. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Southwest, Maple Ridge: 36 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 7 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 19%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 6 of 12 Maple Ridge communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Southwest fell from 63 in June to 36 in October (−42.9%), and 37 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 9.3% of Maple Ridge’s 388 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Southwest?
Southwest also had 10 condos and townhomes listed and 1 sold in October, against 36 houses listed. The Southwest condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Southwest?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 36 houses listed in Southwest. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Southwest a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Southwest had a sales ratio of 19%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Southwest from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 37 houses sold in Southwest over those 5 months, out of 247 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Southwest?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
